map.STEMI 与时间的关系？: What is the relation between STEMI and time?
map.TIMI 评分包含哪些项目？: What items does the TIMI score include?
map.TIMI 评分累加（STEMI 30 天死亡风险）：年龄 ≥75、≥65 且 <: TIMI score accumulation (30-day mortality in STEMI): age >=75, >=65 and <75, diabetes/hypertension/angina history, systolic <100, heart rate >100, Killip class >=2, weight <67 kg, anterior ST elevation or LBBB, and onset >=4h count 1 each (0-14 total).
map.→ 打开心梗 TIMI 危险分层（STEMI 30天死亡风险）工具: -> Open the myocardial infarction TIMI risk stratification (STEMI 30-day mortality) tool
map.共 8 项：年龄分层、危险因素（糖尿病/高血压/心绞痛）、休克体征（收缩压低、心: 8 items in total: age stratification, risk factors (diabetes/hypertension/angina), shock signs (low systolic, fast heart rate), Killip class >=2, low body weight, anterior ST elevation or LBBB, and treatment delay >=4h, 1 point each, with the 0-14 total mapping to increasing 30-day mortality.
map.再灌注决策辅助：高危患者优先急诊 PCI 或溶栓，并加强 ICU 监护与并发症预: Reperfusion decision aid: high-risk patients get priority emergency PCI or thrombolysis, with stronger ICU monitoring and complication prevention.
map.危险分层：分值越高 30 天死亡风险越大（如 ≥4 分属高危），用于再灌注策略与: Risk stratification: the higher the score, the greater the 30-day mortality risk (for example >=4 is high risk), used for reperfusion strategy and monitoring intensity decisions.
map.基于年龄、生命体征、Killip 分级、体重、梗死部位、就诊时间及合并症评估急性: Assess acute STEMI prognosis from age, vital signs, Killip class, weight, infarct location, time to treatment and comorbidities.
map.心梗 TIMI 危险分层（STEMI 30天死亡风险） 使用指南: Myocardial infarction TIMI risk stratification (STEMI 30-day mortality) user guide
map.心肌坏死随闭塞时间进展，门球时间（进门至球囊）越短预后越好，指南强调发病 12h: Myocardial necrosis progresses with occlusion time, so the shorter the door-to-balloon time the better the prognosis; guidelines stress opening the vessel within 12h of onset, especially within 12h of symptoms, while beyond the window with ongoing ischaemia an individualised assessment applies.
map.房颤 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 栓塞风险评估器: Atrial fibrillation CHA₂DS₂-VASc thromboembolic risk assessor
map.评分高就一定手术吗？: Does a high score definitely mean surgery?
map.高分提示高危，再灌注（PCI 或溶栓）与强化监护获益更大，但是否手术还看发病时间: A high score flags high risk, where reperfusion (PCI or thrombolysis) and stronger monitoring gain more, but whether to operate also depends on the time window, bleeding risk and imaging. The score is a decision aid rather than the sole basis.
map.默认数据演练（STEMI TIMI 风险评分）: Default data walkthrough (STEMI TIMI risk score)
